notes.title: Anti-Cheat Protection Is Not Registered in Production
notes.problem: AntiCheatManager still defines Creative/Spectator correction for non-admin players, but the v1.1.3 production bootstrap does not import or instantiate it. The current lobby owner now independently normalizes ordinary participants to Adventure, so this module is dead/overlapping protection rather than evidence that lobby role normalization is missing.
notes.action: Decide whether AntiCheatManager remains an intended defense-in-depth owner. If not, remove the dead module; if it is required, register it without duplicating the active ArenaService role policy.

evidence.finding: v1.1.3 main.js still does not register AntiCheatManager, while ArenaService.normalizeLobbyRole() now sets ordinary lobby participants to Adventure and disables mayfly.

notes.title: Correct the Daylight-Cycle GameRules Property Name
notes.problem: Build & Decode intends to keep daylight cycling disabled. In v1.1.3, WorldData still uses the key doDaylightCycle while the @minecraft/server GameRules property is doDayLightCycle, so the setup code does not reliably own/reassert that rule if world state changes later.
notes.action: Correct the existing WorldData/WorldManager gamerule key to doDayLightCycle and keep the same world-setup owner. Do not create a second gamerule authority.

notes.title: Clarify Whether Guessers Should Receive Mayfly During Active Rounds
notes.problem: In v1.1.3, the active-round role application still enables mayfly for every playing participant, including Adventure-mode guessers. Current artifact evidence is insufficient to classify this as a defect, but it materially changes how guessers can move and view the build.
notes.action: Confirm the intended guesser movement policy. If flight is builder-only, scope mayfly to builders in both activateRound() and reconnect/applyRole(); otherwise document that guesser flight is intentional.

evidence.finding: activateRound() sets builders to Creative and guessers to Adventure, then applies 'ability @s mayfly true' to every playing participant.
